subject: Next steps: Neptune evaluation plan, success metrics, and exec readout
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Burns <claire.burns@neptunehealth.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@neptunehealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + proposed evaluation criteria for Neptune POC

Thanks again for a productive discovery, Claire and Tom — appreciate the candid detail on workflows and volume. Below is a concise recap and the evaluation plan we discussed. Please confirm or flag anything we missed so we can lock the kickoff date.

Quick recap of objectives
- Primary goal: automate clinical note enrichment to reduce triage time for specialists by 30%
- Secondary: increase structured data capture for billing by 15%

Proposed success criteria (attached as spreadsheet):
- Latency: median inference P95 < 450ms for 1–2 concurrent analysts
- Accuracy: entity extraction F1 >= 0.86 on the Neptune test set
- Business impact: 30% reduction in manual triage time in pilot cohort

Trial scope & timeline (draft)
- Week 0: kickoff & env access
- Weeks 1–3: integration, sample ingestion, smoke tests
- Weeks 4–6: evaluation runs, metric collection
- Week 7: internal readout + go/no-go prep
- Week 8: executive readout and decision

Owners (RACI)
- Integration / infra: Sean Gallagher
- Pilot ops / data: Claire Burns (Neptune) + Vanessa Ortiz
- Success metrics / evaluation: Vanessa Ortiz & Neptune analytics

Attachments: Neptune-POC-success-criteria.xlsx (xlsx) — tabbed with baseline + target metrics.

Ask: can you confirm the two success metrics above and whether Priya from procurement should be looped in now for contract timing? Also, what compliance artifacts would you want ahead of kickoff (SOC2, data-flow diagram, data retention policy)?

Thanks — will pencil 6/23 for a kickoff until I hear from you.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Claire Burns <claire.burns@neptunehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@neptunehealth.com>, Priya Desai <p.desai@procure.neptunehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 10:33:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed evaluation criteria for Neptune POC

Vanessa — thanks for the thorough recap. The criteria look good; a couple of quick notes from our side:

- Accuracy target: we can validate F1 on our annotated set but please add precision/recall breakdowns in the evaluation report.
- Latency: 450ms P95 is acceptable for our analyst flow; can you confirm if that assumes the KV cache is warm?
- Timeline: 6/23 kickoff is tight for procurement; can we aim for week of 6/30 instead? Priya (procurement) is on-copy — she can advise on SOW/contract lead times.

Procurement ask: Priya, do you need a draft term sheet or statement of work to start internal review? We will also request SOC2 Type II and a data-flow diagram before production access. Vanessa, if you have a short compliance packet we can circulate, that would speed things up.

Attachment: data-flow-diagram.pdf (pdf) — internal Neptune appendix referenced.

On Thu, Jun 12, 2025 at 07:12 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for a productive discovery...

Best,
Claire Burns
Director, Clinical Operations
Neptune Health
claire.burns@neptunehealth.com | +1 212-555-0987

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Burns <claire.burns@neptunehealth.com>, Priya Desai <p.desai@procure.neptunehealth.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@neptunehealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft Neptune trial plan + owners (internal)

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Claire. Priya — great to have you looped in; we'll put a term sheet into Draft for your review.

Internal note (summarized here for visibility):
- Sean: you'll lead the integration sprint and validation infra (test buckets, minimal sample loader).
- Priyom: can you own scheduling and the kickoff invite? I also want you to maintain the mutual action plan document and update assignees after kickoff.
- Vanessa / Neptune analytics: Vanessa to own the metric dashboard and go/no-go recommendation.

Attached: Neptune_poc_plan_v1.docx — includes a step-by-step runbook, minimal test data spec, and the evaluation scoring rubric.

Two clarifying answers:
- Latency assumption: 450ms P95 assumes KV cache warm and single-shard requests; we'll include a cold-cache appendix in the runbook.
- Compliance packet: I'll share a short bundle (SOC2 summary, data retention, SAQ) by EOD Monday.

If Neptune prefers week of 6/30 for kickoff, propose Tues 7/1 or Wed 7/2 morning PT — Priyom, please propose calendar slots.

Thanks — V

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>

Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec readout cadence & contracting next steps (Neptune POC)

Claire / Tom / Priya — thanks for confirming the kickoff this week. Quick note to align on the final decision loop and contracting path so everyone is clear on the exec readout expectations.

Proposed executive readout workflow
- Internal readout (working group): 1 business day after final evaluation (owner: Vanessa)
- Executive panel (Neptune execs + Redwood VP GTM): schedule 3 business days after internal readout
- Decision window: panel makes a go/no-go (or ask for follow-up) on the call; follow-up actions captured to the mutual action plan

Suggested timing (based on proposed 6-week evaluation):
- Final evaluation complete: Tue, 29 Jul 2025
- Internal readout: Wed, 30 Jul 2025
- Executive panel: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 (ask for 30–45 minutes)

Contracting path & practical asks
- Priya: would you like a term sheet first (non-binding) or shall we send a redlineable draft SOW + terms? We can prefill the purchase order fields to speed approvals.
- For our side: I'll circulate redwood-term-sheet_v2.pdf as a preview (attached). If Priya wants a DocuSign stub to start routing approvals, we can provide that after we agree on the high-level commercial points.

Immediate asks before kickoff
- Neptune: confirm who will be on the exec panel (names & roles) so we can include them in the invitation
- Procurement: if a pre-approved vendor form or BAU PO template is required, please share it so we can attach it to the term sheet

I'll prepare the internal readout slide deck (metrics + examples + risks) once we have the first two weeks of evaluation metrics. Posting it to the shared Drive folder for comment.

Attachments: redwood-term-sheet_v2.pdf

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
